Name: Pokemon Berry Bushes
Author: TntDove
Description:
[b][u]IF YOU ARE UPDATING FROM 1.1.3: I'VE DONE MY BEST TO MAKE PRE-EXISTING SAVES MIGRATE OVER, BUT CROPS THAT HAVE YET TO BE HARVESTED AND GIANT CROPS AND LIKELY OTHER THINGS MAY APPEAR AS ERRORS ON EXISTING SAVES. I'M SORRY, I DON'T THINK I CAN PREVENT THAT. EXISTING OBJECTS IN INVENTORY AND CHESTS SHOULD CARRY OVER.[/u][/b]
[line]

This mod adds a bunch of Pokemon related content, primarily 67 new crops which can be purchased in various locations across the first 3 years, as well as recipes to make sure each of these berries has something they can be used in!
There are also plenty of secrets to find! There may even be a hint to one somewhere on this very mod page...
This mod also includes a status condition system! As far as I'm aware it's not possible (or at least extremely difficult) to have existing monsters inflict debuffs, so instead you get these status conditions from eating certain foods (make sure to carry around other foods that can cure these conditions!). There is a config option to disable this system if you don't like it.

This pack does NOT include the Hopo berry from Legends Arceus or Generation 2 berries.

These crops and recipes may also not be balanced as most of them are multi-harvest.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SP-6HQWB4v9Ux3F_0wE-kIrdGNQbEb8HHHlaG7kL24k]Here[/url] is a crude guide for where to find the recipes for dishes as well as where to purchase seeds from the mod, among other things. If you want more information added to the table please comment and I'll try to get to it eventually!
This was put together VERY quickly and I am an amateur when it comes to spreadsheets so it doesn't look very pretty. I might make it look better at some point, especially as more information is requested!
